section: Iterate — bug: one source for the unresolved-license count
title: SBOM render owns the unresolved-license count
context: The dashboard counted only the literal 'unknown' license and missed not-installed packages, so it showed 0 unresolved while sbom.md reported 8.
decision: Add sbom_render.unresolved_count (declared-none plus not-installed); the SBOM generator and the Control Grade dependency line both call it. The dashboard's private set is removed.
consequences: Both surfaces always show the same number; a test pins it on a fixture. Dependency-hygiene scores may drop for repos with uninstalled dependencies.
rationale: One definition next to _classify cannot drift; the SBOM is the documented source of truth.
rejected: Keeping two counters and syncing them by test only: drift recurs on the next change.
